2105-7431-8296-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-7431-8296-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-7431-8296-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Daydream from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Daydream from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

4452-5411-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
4452-5411-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability, giving a creature haste until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

5789-5900-8160.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
5789-5900-8160.notes: Alternate adding {G} and {U} each time. Start by adding the opposite of whatever mana you provide for the {G/U} in the cost.

1510-4574-5849-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Arcbound Stinger.
When Arcbound Stinger dies, its modular ability triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Arcbound Stinger from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Arcbound Stinger from the top of your library by paying {0} due to Fortune Teller's Talent.
Repeat.

2178-4170-4871-6495.notablePrerequisites:
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional artifact.
2178-4170-4871-6495.description:
Activate Fain's third ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the Inkling.
When the Inkling dies, Fain and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Fain trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
2178-4170-4871-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

250-779-1479-5411-7892.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5411-7892.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1479-5411-7892.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Thranduil the Strategist and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Thranduil the Strategist triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

4559-5147-7306-7430.notablePrerequisites:
Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
You've had two creatures die under your control this turn.
4559-5147-7306-7430.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gorma.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, Gorma and The Ooze trigger.
Resolve The Ooze's trigger, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve Gorma's trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

240-413-5470-7297.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 3.

5184-5742-5743-7178.description:
Activate Iron-Shield Elf by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Iron-Shield Elf ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2506-2719-6753-7150.description:
Cast Kirol by paying {1}{R/W}{R/W}
When Kirol enters, Molten Echoes triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and another creature you control, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Molten Echoes's ability, creating two token copies of Kirol with haste.
Holding priority, activate a Kirol token by tapping both Kirol tokens, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

620-3532-3536-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
620-3532-3536-5078.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name "Sensei's Divining Top".
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Yotian Dissident.
Repeat from step 2

630-1322-2366-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
630-1322-2366-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Keeper of Progenitus triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

2866-3689-5060-6518.notablePrerequisites: There is a [type] card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
2866-3689-5060-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1170-4124-5334-5954-6763.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

252-4871-4927.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature and have a way to cause that creature to die.
252-4871-4927.description:
Kill any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

1429-2921-5402-5929.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-2921-5402-5929.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2770-3140-6085.description:
Cast Donate by paying {2}{U}, giving control of Altanak to an opponent.
Activate Soltari Guerrillas an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting Altanak.
Altanak triggers that many times, causing an opponent to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.

962-1247-4613.notablePrerequisites:
Yurlok of Scorch Thrash does not have summoning sickness.
Yurlok of Scorch Thrash has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
962-1247-4613.description:
Activate Yurlok of Scorch Thrash by paying {1} and tapping it, causing each player to add {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Yurlok of Scorch Thrash using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
It is strongly recommended to empty your mana pool using a mana sink before proceeding.
Move to your next step or phase, causing each player to lose life equal to the amount of unspent mana in their mana pool.
Each player whose mana pool contained an amount of mana equal to or greater than their life total loses the game due to having 0 or less life, which causes a draw if every player lost the game.

643-3510-3678.notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand.
643-3510-3678.description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters the battlefield as a 1/1 Saproling that is also a Forest land due to Life and Limb and Maskwood Nexus, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
Repeat step 3.

942-2281-4050-4871.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Samwise.
Saffi dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Saffi ability.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Samwise, adding {G}.
When Samwise dies, Saffi and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Samwise from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Samwise enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Cast Saffi by paying {G}{W}.
Repeat.

676-2633-3940.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three creature tokens.
676-2633-3940.description:
Cast Haze of Rage with buyback by paying {R}.
Urabrask and Haze of Rage's storm ability triggers.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and adding {R}.
Resolve the Haze of Rage trigger, copying Haze of Rage for each spell cast before it this turn.
Resolve all Haze of Rages, giving creatures you control +1/+0 until end of turn for each Haze of Rage, and returning the original Haze of Rage to your hand.
Repeat.

215-2557-4050-4555-5176.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven Forests.
215-2557-4050-4555-5176.description:
Cast Tangle Golem by paying {0}.
Radagast triggers, creating two 3/3 Beast creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Beasts, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Tangle Golem from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

215-2060-3150-3771.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least six +1/+1 counters on it.
215-2060-3150-3771.description:
Cast Broodlord, choosing {3} for X, but paying a total of {G} due to Animar.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Broodlord enters the battlefield, putting three +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Broodlord from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
You may choose larger numbers for X in future iterations to get infinite +1/+1 counters, colored mana, and card draw.

717-779-3251-4542.description:
Cast Psychic Miasma by paying {1}{B}, targeting yourself.
Null Profusion triggers, allowing you to draw a card.
If Dakmor Salvage is in your graveyard, instead replace drawing a card with milling two cards, and returning Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Psychic Miasma, discarding Dakmor Salvage and returning Psychic Miasma to your hand.
Bone Miser's second ability triggers, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

2060-2854-3062-3977.notablePrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds has 2 or 3 lore counters on it.
2060-2854-3062-3977.description:
Cast Horned Kavu, putting 2 +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler with Showdown of the Skalds.
Remove 2 +1/+1 counter from Crystalline Crawler to add {R}{G}.
Horned Kavu triggers, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.

168-736-2210-4768.description:
Cast Mirrormade by paying {2}{U}.
Mirrormade enters the battlefield as a copy of Oblivion Ring, triggering Altar of the Brood and itself.
Resolve the Altar of Brood trigger, causing each opponent to mill a card.
Resolve the Mirrormade's trigger, exiling Oblivion Ring.
Cast Copy Enchantment by paying {2}{U}.
Copy Enchantment enters the battlefield as a copy of the Oblivion Ring copy, triggering Altar of the Brood and itself.
Resolve the Altar of Brood trigger, causing each opponent to mill a card.
Resolve the Copy Enchantment's trigger, exiling Mirrormade.
Mirrormade leaves the battlefield, triggering itself, returning Oblivion Ring from exile to the battlefield.
Altar of the Brood and Oblivion Ring trigger.
Resolve the Altar of Brood trigger, causing each opponent to mill a card.
Resolve the Oblivion Ring trigger, exiling Copy Enchantment.
Copy Enchantment leaves the battlefield, returning Mirrormade from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 until each opponent has an empty library, then end the loop by choosing to copy or exile any other permanent.
